info.cls_name: 商學進修二學位學程甲班
info.cls_ename: Continuing Education Bachelor's Program of Business

description.describe_ch: 提供學生們與導師建立互動機會，形成良好夥伴關係，以發展實現學生個人、學業、職涯目標，確保及達成學生學習成就。提供生涯規劃及選課諮詢，並導引善用學校各項學習資源與服務，獲得各種學習能力資訊及機會，輔助學生建立完整的學習經驗及歷程，讓學生個人的學習發展，朝向永續學習及成功之路。
description.describe_eh: Providing the interactive opportunity establishes in the students and academic advisor, forms the good partnership. develops realizes student individual, the studies, the duty border goal, guarantees and achieves the student to study the achievement. Provides the profession plan and chooses the class consultation, and guides makes good use of the school each study resources and the service, obtains each kind of learning capability information and the opportunity, the auxiliary student establishes the complete learning experience and the course, lets the student individual study development, faces continues forever to study and the steps to success.

targets.describe_ch: 班級活動及諮詢：培養學生責任感與凝聚班級向心力。
targets.describe_en: Class Activities Operation and Advising: Cultivate students' responsibilities and enhance the sense of belonging.

targets.describe_ch: 個人成長：協助同學發展核心軟技能及決策制訂能力，以及從各種學習經驗當中獲得綜合技能並能適時運用之。
targets.describe_en: Personal growth: Develop core soft skills and decision-making. Be able to identify and communicate the transferable skills gained through your educational experience.

targets.describe_ch: 資源應用：幫助同學分配與有效利用校園資源服務的技巧以達成學生目標。
targets.describe_en: Resource identification: Develop skills in locating and effectively using information and resources that help you achieve your goals.

targets.describe_ch: 職涯規劃：讓同學瞭解在課堂學習經驗與個人學業、職涯及制訂目標之間的關係。
targets.describe_en: Curriculum integration: Understand the relationship between your classroom experiences and your academic, career, and personal goals.

targets.describe_ch: 經驗學習：瞭解包含課堂外學習經驗的重要性。
targets.describe_en: Experiential learning: Understand the importance of including experiences outside of the classroom in your educational plan.
